components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      properties:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:

          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:

          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\D*(\d\D*){10}$'

## What I changed

The spec: when no registration date is supplied on `POST /api/owners`, default it to the server's current date, and expose `registrationDate` as an ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` string.

To keep structural impact low, I added behaviour as small cohesive units rather than touching any large method:

1. **`model/Owner.java`** — new `registrationDate` field (`LocalDate`) with a trivial getter/setter (CC 1 each) and a small `@PrePersist` hook (CC 2) that fills in `LocalDate.now()` only when the field is null. No existing method was modified.

2. **`resources/openapi.yml`** — added an optional `registrationDate` (`type: string, format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` schema, so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` gain a `LocalDate` field. Jackson serializes it as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

3. **Schema files** (`db/{hsqldb,h2,postgres,mysql}/schema.sql`) — added the `registration_date DATE` column to the `owners` table.

Notably I did **not** touch `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` or `OwnerMapper`: MapStruct auto-maps the same-named `registrationDate` property in both directions, and the `@PrePersist` default runs at save time (after mapping), so the supplied value is preserved when present and defaulted when absent. The two hot paths (a large controller method and the mapper interface) stayed untouched.
